meta.title: Installation for appliance brands
meta.description: Bluebolt takes installation orders from appliance brands, dispatches technicians, signs off with photos and reconciles per job, with SLAs by region.

brands.title: Installation and warranty work for appliance brands
brands.lead: One partner to dispatch technicians, sign off jobs and reconcile your installation orders.

pains.title: Why is installation quality so hard for brands to control?
pains.lead: Once installation orders spread across provinces, brands tend to run into the same five problems.

people.title: Technicians spread across provinces
people.body: Every area has its own team, its own way of communicating and its own reporting.
people.answer: One dispatch partner: the brand sends the order, Bluebolt assigns the nearest technician with the right skills.

quality.title: Inconsistent quality
quality.body: The same product gets installed differently in every place, and customers complain to the brand.
quality.answer: Technicians install to the brand's guidelines and sign off with the customer using photos.

speed.title: Slow order handling
speed.body: Nobody is sure which stage an order is stuck at, or who has it.
speed.answer: Every job has a status across five steps, from intake to reconciliation.

cost.title: Costs that are hard to control
cost.body: Extra charges at the customer's home have no reference to check against.
cost.answer: Service fees are set by contract; parts follow a published reference price list.

sla.title: SLAs you cannot measure
sla.body: You promise customers a timeframe but have no data to check it.
sla.answer: Each job's timestamps are recorded so they can be checked against the regional SLA.

sla.title: Time commitments by region
sla.lead: Three milestones a brand needs to measure on every job: appointment confirmation, installation completion and installation fault fixes.

process.title: From brand order to reconciliation in five steps
process.lead: Every job goes through the same five steps, so the brand always knows where an order is and who has it.

billing.title: Two payments, kept separate from the start
billing.lead: An installation job carries a service fee between the brand and Bluebolt, and may also involve extra parts at the customer's home. The two follow separate paths.

fee.title: Installation service fee
fee.payer: Paid by the brand to Bluebolt

channel.q: How does a brand send installation orders to Bluebolt?
channel.a: Through the channel both sides agree on when signing the contract. The exact channel is settled during the demo.

devices.a: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette air conditioners; washing machines, dryers and refrigerators; wall-mounted TVs, induction hobs, cooker hoods, water purifiers and water heaters; robot vacuums.

coverage.q: Does Bluebolt have technicians in our provinces?
coverage.a: Check the province table on the Network page, or send us the list of provinces you need and the sales team will confirm.

responsibility.q: Who is responsible for faults after installation?
responsibility.a: Responsibilities are set out in the contract: product faults and installation faults follow two separate processes.

warranty.q: How long is the installation warranty?
warranty.a: The warranty period depends on the type of service and is set out in the warranty policy.

materials.q: How are extra parts charged, and are they invoiced?
materials.a: The customer and the technician agree on site using the reference parts prices, and the customer pays the technician directly.

tracking.q: Where can a brand follow the progress of its orders?
tracking.a: Every job has a status across the five steps, plus sign-off photos. How reports reach the brand is agreed in the contract.

cta.title: See how Bluebolt handles an installation job in 30 minutes
cta.body: Tell us your product category, monthly order volume and the provinces you need covered. The sales team will contact you to schedule the demo and prepare a quote.
